These are excluded categories under the policy (adjunct, research_only/research_staff, emeritus/retired_working, and DFOR-related listings); no records were created for them and they are not omissions.
No officially announced incoming ECE professors appear on the four primary list pages, so the included set has no incoming records and effective_from_json is null for all 36 people.
